title: Balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in Nature

questions.prompt: What keeps a natural balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in Nature?
questions.why: Respiration and photosynthesis keep the balance.
questions.quote: Respiration and photosynthesis keep a balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in Nature.

questions.prompt: What do living things take up during respiration?
questions.why: Respiration consumes oxygen from the atmosphere.
questions.quote: When living things carry out respiration, they take up oxygen from the atmosphere.

questions.prompt: Where does the oxygen taken up in respiration get replaced?
options: By oxygen produced by plants during photosynthesis
questions.why: Photosynthesis in plants produces the replacement oxygen.
questions.quote: The oxygen is replaced by the oxygen produced by plants during photosynthesis.

questions.prompt: What do plants do with the carbon dioxide produced by living things?
questions.why: Plants absorb carbon dioxide for photosynthesis.
questions.quote: The carbon dioxide is taken up by plants for photosynthesis.

questions.prompt: Which human activities disrupt the balance of carbon dioxide?
options: Burning fossil fuels and clearing forests
questions.why: Fossil fuel burning and forest clearing disrupt the balance.
questions.quote: Some human activities (e.g. burning fossil fuels and clearing forests) are disrupting the balance of carbon dioxide in Nature.

questions.prompt: Which gases trap thermal energy in the atmosphere?
options: Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide
questions.why: Greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide trap thermal energy.
questions.quote: Some gases that are naturally present in the atmosphere (e.g. carbon dioxide) trap thermal energy in the atmosphere.

questions.prompt: What does the greenhouse effect keep the Earth's surface at?
questions.why: The greenhouse effect keeps the surface warm enough for life.
questions.quote: The greenhouse effect is an important natural process. It keeps the Earth's surface at a temperature suitable for life.

questions.prompt: What does the increasing amount of carbon dioxide enhance?
questions.why: More carbon dioxide traps more heat and strengthens the greenhouse effect.
questions.quote: The increasing amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere traps more thermal energy and enhances the greenhouse effect.

questions.prompt: What is the rise in average temperatures of the Earth known as?
questions.why: The rise in global temperatures is global warming.
questions.quote: This is known as global warming.

questions.prompt: What happens to living things in the Polar regions as ice melts?
options: They lose their habitats and die
questions.why: Polar ice melting destroys habitats and kills polar species.
questions.quote: Living things in the Polar regions (e.g. Polar Bear) lose their habitats and die.

questions.prompt: When was the atmospheric carbon dioxide level relatively constant?
questions.why: The carbon dioxide level was relatively constant before the 1700s.
questions.quote: The level was relatively constant before 1700s. But it has risen sharply in the last few hundred years.

questions.prompt: Since when has energy needs increased greatly?
questions.why: Energy needs increased greatly since the Industrial Revolution.
questions.quote: Since the Industrial Revolution in the late 1700s, the energy needs for transport, industrial activities

questions.prompt: What does burning fossil fuels release?
questions.why: Burning fossil fuels releases a lot of carbon dioxide.
questions.quote: The burning of fossil fuels releases a lot of carbon dioxide.

questions.prompt: What are large areas of forest cleared to obtain?
questions.why: Large areas of forest are cleared to obtain timber or land.
questions.quote: large areas of forest have been cleared to obtain timber or land

questions.prompt: Besides carbon dioxide, what other gas is a major greenhouse gas?
questions.why: Methane is also a major greenhouse gas.
questions.quote: Apart from carbon dioxide, methane is also a major greenhouse gas.

questions.prompt: One source of methane is rearing of which animals?
questions.why: Methane is released by rearing animals such as cattle and sheep.
questions.quote: One of its sources is rearing of animals such as cattle and sheep.

questions.prompt: What is the Moon's average surface temperature?
questions.why: The Moon's average surface temperature is –18 °C.
questions.quote: the average temperature of its surface is –18 °C

questions.prompt: How did the Arctic Ocean ice in 2020 compare with 1980?
questions.why: The Arctic Ocean ice in 2020 was much smaller than in 1980.
questions.quote: Ice covering the Arctic Ocean was much smaller in 2020 compared with that in 1980.

questions.prompt: Which is an unusual weather pattern possibly caused by climate change?
questions.why: Climate change may lead to unusual weather patterns such as more typhoons.
questions.quote: Unusual weather patterns may result, e.g. more typhoons

questions.prompt: What temperature rise limit did countries agree to?
